A PhD at Wageningen University & Research
Admission requirements
Admission requirements
Intro
The following requirements are needed to start a PhD at Wageningen University & Research (WUR).
Proof of funding
Proof of funding
To be able to start a PhD at Wageningen University & Research funding must be guaranteed.
Scholarship candidates can only be accepted to the Wageningen PhD programme in case they meet one of the following conditions applicable at the time of admission (these conditions will be adjusted/increased every 6 months):
A scholarship with an amount for living allowances that is sufficient for the whole PhD trajectory (for candidates starting between 1 July 2026 and 1 January 2027 this amount is € 1950,- per month), or;
A scholarship with an amount for living allowances that is equivalent to the minimum income requirements by the Dutch Immigration and Naturalisation Services (IND)* and a guaranteed future adherence to the minimum income requirements. This should be included in the agreement between the scholarship PhD candidate and the scholarship provider. The minimum income requirement is € 1767,- from 1 July 2026 to 1 January 2027.
It is not allowed to provide a financial ‘top-up’ ourselves as an organisation. Also, the scholarship cannot be complemented with funds of the PhD candidate/family themselves.
* According to the ‘IND minimum income requirements’, a PhD candidate should be able to demonstrate that he/she has sufficient and sustainable income when coming to the Netherlands. More information about the IND minimum income requirements can be found on the immigration website from the Dutch government.

Master's degree
Master's degree
The candidate must hold a master’s degree that is comparable to a Dutch master’s degree.
All diploma documents will be evaluated by the Doctoral Service Centre of Wageningen University & Research. They determine whether a credential evaluation by Nuffic (the Dutch organisation for internationalisation in education) is required.
Master’s degrees obtained in the Netherlands and within the European Higher Education Area are automatically recognised by Wageningen University & Research. However, all diplomas will still be assessed for authenticity and accreditation.
For detailed information about the required documents and indicative processing times please visit our required documents page.
English language proficiency
English language proficiency
In order to be admitted, all PhD candidates must meet the English language requirement as well as the Dutch language requirement when the thesis is written in Dutch. Candidates can meet the English language requirement either by being exempted:
Being a national of a country where English is the national language;
The holder of a Master degree fully taught in the English language;
The holder of a Master Degree from a Dutch University or from a Dutch University of Applied Sciences.
Or by uploading a valid certificate of proficiency in the English Language. Please note that in both cases the relevant documents must be uploaded in the university registration system well in time.
